description:
Configure the Inbound Group 'SUPPORT' to handle after-hours and overflow traffic.

Target Configuration:
1. Set the Call Time to 'BIZ_HRS'.
2. configure the After Hours Action to go to Voicemail Box '8500'.
3. Configure the 'No Agent No Queue' Action to go to Voicemail Box '8500'.
4. Configure the Wait Time Option to go to Voicemail Box '8500' if the hold time exceeds 90 seconds.

Starting State:
- Inbound Group 'SUPPORT' exists.
- Call Time 'BIZ_HRS' exists.
- Voicemail Box '8500' exists.
- You are logged into Vicidial Admin.

Navigate to Inbound > Show In-Groups to begin.
